review_note: Reviewed the eleven course links from the AI emphasis. Undergraduate prerequisite or pre/corequisite labels are preserved separately from graduate prerequisites. Paired undergraduate/graduate codes do not establish undergraduate access to the graduate course. The emphasis labels 4550 as CSCI(PHIL), while its own linked Bulletin record labels it CSCI(ARTI); preserve that source-specific cross-list discrepancy. CSCI 4900/6900 is a variable 1–4 hour topics course, repeatable to a maximum 14 hours; neither range nor repeat maximum is a fixed course amount. Its AI topic requires the existing approval rule. Published hours remain unnormalized. Course-specific learning outcomes are not promoted to program outcomes. The September 30, 2025 announcement says the emphasis is approved; only the requirements page explicitly states availability starting Fall 2026. That is an availability statement, not independent first-enrollment evidence.
